name: Takayashiki Matsuri
source: She ran away from home due to some adverse circumstances and lives in in the park in a cardboard house. Works in a toy factory to earn a living. She fled to the house when the box was broken by a storm. Follower of yaoi as a hobby. She also harbors strong feeling of anchoring relationships and somehow tries to have a close family, and is instrumental in persuading Tsukasa to join the Family Project.
